title: City of Second Chances（都市逆袭 · 北美）

character_bible.name: Lin Hai
character_bible.role: 主角：外卖员 → 出海品牌创始人
character_bible.look: 工装外套 → 创业者衬衫；短发；黑色双肩包
character_bible.anchor_prompt: young asian male founder, short black hair, confident, minimal wardrobe

shots.dialogue: They said a delivery boy can't build an empire.
shots.visual_note: 钩子：夜景都市俯瞰，人物未现身先给世界观

shots.dialogue: Six months later — forty-seven stores, three cities.
shots.visual_note: 时间跳切：窗框内的城市天际线

shots.dialogue: My first warehouse was a bicycle basket.
Every rejection letter became my business plan.
Now my brand ships to every port in America.
shots.visual_note: 港口集装箱 = 出海意象

shots.dialogue: The city that ignored me now wears my name.
shots.visual_note: 回到开篇场景形成呼应

shots.dialogue: New York didn't change. I did.
If I made it — so can you. Follow for Episode 2.
